nodes_add.name: Allan Bennett (Ananda Metteya)
nodes_add.note: Former Golden Dawn member who became a Buddhist monk; mentored Brunton (New Dawn profile; encyclopedia.com). Dates not recorded in sources read.

nodes_update.name: Paul Brunton
nodes_update.note: b. Hyman Abraham Isaacs, London, 21 Oct 1898; India from 1930, Ramana 1931; A Search in Secret India 1934; Overself and Mentalism in Hidden Teaching Beyond Yoga (1941) and Wisdom of the Overself (1943); Notebooks 1984-88; d. Vevey 27 Jul 1981.

edges_upsert.note: Bennett introduced Brunton to Buddhist meditation (encyclopedia.com); mentor per New Dawn profile.
Met Meher Baba in India (Wikipedia); first trip aimed at meeting him (New Dawn profile).

places.name: Vevey
places.what: Lived in Switzerland in later years; died here, 27 Jul 1981

glossary.def: Brunton's term for the higher Self; in his system it is identical at the highest level with the World Mind.
Brunton's doctrine that matter has no independent existence and is a form taken by mental processes.

issues: paul-brunton: Sources are secondary (Wikipedia, advaita.org.uk, New Dawn profile on paulbrunton.org, encyclopedia.com); A Search in Secret India itself was not read. Conflicts: Wikipedia has Ramana first visit 1931 and 'Hurst' name; encyclopedia.com has Switzerland from 1956, Secret Path 1959 and 'Perspectives' 7,000 pages, and says he left Theosophy after two years while New Dawn says he joined 1920; New Dawn says a second India stay 1935-37 and PhD from a diploma mill (not used); page counts differ (20,000 / 30,000). Meher Baba meeting 1930-31 date approximate. Masson's My Father's Guru (1993) is omitted as outside the scope brief. Kenneth Hurst's Personal View (1989) not read.
